headline: Public hearings on National Grid pole and underground conduit petitions, including on Blaine Street, Eastern Avenue, and Lynn Street.
summary: Public hearings will be held on National Grid petitions for new poles and underground conduits. The agenda also covers Board of Health reappointments, zoning and salary ordinances, and budget transfers.
items: Reappoint Dr. Scune Carrington to the Board of Health, with term expiring October 22, 2029 (440-26).
Reappoint John Colangeli to the Board of Health, with term expiring October 22, 2029 (441-26).
Reappoint Dr. Kunwar Singh to the Board of Health, with term expiring October 22, 2029 (442-26).
Public hearings on National Grid Plan No. 31286263 to install new poles and underground conduits on Blaine Street, Hancock Road, Lynn Street, Eastern Avenue, and Broadway (444-26).
Motion to set the motel-hotel maximum height in the Code of the City of Malden at 6 stories, not to exceed 75 ft. (445-26).
Ordinance to move supervision of the Animal Control Officer from Section 2.12.165 (Police Department) to Section 2.12.105 (Department of Public Health and Human Services) (446-26).

Order to reduce the FY2027 Department of Public Works appropriation by $800,000, from $9,525,480 to $8,725,480, with the FY2026 snow and ice deficit to be raised on the FY2027 tax recapitulation report (448-26).
Ordinance to amend the use regulations in Code Section 12.12.030 (327-26).
Ordinance to add an assistant department head salary schedule to Title 2, Chapter 24 (415-26).
Committee report on Papers 335 and 335A: ordinance to replace Code Section 12.12.300, Inclusionary Zoning (335-26), and ordinance to add a new subsection F, Incentives (335A-26).
Committee report on Papers 427 and 428: order to transfer $157,000 from Salary Reserve to several accounts (427-26), and order to transfer $220,000 from Salary Reserve to Police Salaries (428-26).
location: City Council Chambers, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA 02148

## 6. HEARINGS, PETITIONS, MEMORIALS, AND REMONSTRANCES

Council will hold public hearings on National Grid petitions to install five new poles and underground conduits

**444-26** 

Petition: Massachusetts Electric Company dba National Grid Plan No. 31286263

· National Grid to install one joint owned pole on Blaine Street beginning at a point approximately 60 feet south of the centerline of the intersection of Lynn Street and Blaine Street, in front of 6 Blaine Street. National Grid to install new midspan pole P5145 50 feet south of pole P2023, Malden, MA.

· National Grid to install one joint owned pole on Hancock Road beginning at a point approximately 60 feet east of the centerline of the intersection of Blaine Street and Hancock Road, in front of 24 Blaine Street. National Grid to install new midspan pole P2025-50 60 feet northeast of pole P2025, Malden, MA.

· National Grid to install one joint owned pole on Lynn Street beginning at a point approximately 180 feet west of the centerline of the intersection of Lynn Street and Sargent Street, adjacent to the property line of 148 Bellvale Street. National Grid to install new pole P2003 and anchors 30 feet east of P2002 on Lynn Street, Malden, MA.

· National Grid to install two joint owned poles on Eastern Avenue. National Grid to install new midspan pole P1977 50 feet west of pole P1978, across the street from 1080 Eastern Avenue, and install new midspan pole P2901 55 feet east of pole P1980, across the street from 1114 Eastern Avenue, Malden, MA.

· National Grid to install underground facilities on Broadway and Eastern Avenue beginning at a point 180 feet north of the centerline of the intersection of Broadway and Eastern Avenue and continuing

- approximately 180 feet south on Broadway and then east onto Eastern

Avenue. National Grid to install a new cable duct bank from existing manhole 2-1 on Broadway to new manhole 2-2 on Eastern Avenue to riser Pole P1979 across the street from 1080 Eastern Avenue, Malden, MA.

## 448-26

Ordered: That the FY2027 General Fund appropriation order, Schedule B, for the fiscal year July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027, be and hereby is amended by reducing the appropriation for the Department of Public Works by Eight Hundred Thousand Dollars ($800,000), from Nine Million Five Hundred Twenty-Five Thousand Four Hundred Eighty Dollars ($9,525,480) to Eight Million Seven Hundred Twenty-Five Thousand Four Hundred Eighty Dollars ($8,725,480).

Said reduction shall eliminate the $800,000 appropriated within the Department of Public Works FY2027 budget for the FY2026 snow and ice deficit, which will instead be raised on the FY2027 tax recapitulation report.

All other provisions of the FY2027 appropriation order shall remain unchanged.

Sponsors:

Carey McDonald
